groups.name: Square corners dominate, small radii only
groups.definition: Are most corners square, with only small radii (a few px) and no large or pill rounding?

groups.name: Pill buttons with otherwise square corners
groups.definition: Are buttons fully rounded pills while most other elements stay square or modestly rounded?

groups.name: Bimodal radii avoiding small rounding
groups.definition: Are border radii either square or large (16px+), with few subtle small radii in between?

groups.name: Minimal decoration, no gradients or animation
groups.definition: Is decoration minimal, with no gradients, blur, animations or transforms and few shadows or transitions?

groups.name: Motion limited to simple transitions
groups.definition: Is motion limited to simple CSS transitions, with no keyframe animations, transforms or backdrop blur?

groups.name: Translucent header with backdrop blur
groups.definition: Does the header have a translucent background with backdrop blur?

groups.name: Single hero gradient
groups.definition: Is the hero background a gradient, typically the page's only gradient?

groups.name: Short accent underline bar under headings
groups.definition: Do section headings have a short accent-colored rule or underline bar beneath them?

groups.name: Full-width hairline rules between sections
groups.definition: Are sections or headings separated by thin horizontal rules or alternating background tones?

groups.name: Soft shadows on cards or images
groups.definition: Are cards or featured images lifted with rounded corners and soft drop shadows?

groups.name: Flat bordered cards without shadows
groups.definition: Do cards use thin light borders instead of shadows to separate them?

groups.name: Decorative glyphs instead of icons
groups.definition: Are decorative marks such as stars and carets rendered as text glyphs rather than SVG icons?

groups.name: Effects baked into raster images
groups.definition: Are embossed, metallic or textured effects delivered via images or decorative CSS shapes rather than CSS gradients?

groups.name: Hierarchy without badges or icons
groups.definition: Is hierarchy carried only by weight, case and size, with no badges or decorative icons?

groups.name: Decorative footer photo with halftone accents
groups.definition: Does the footer use a curved-crop photo with halftone-dot decoration?
